items.title: How this field hires a master's student
items.detail: Big pharma opens structured summer programs between September and November (Genentech's Product Development Data Sciences wave, master's included, went up November 11 with an eight-day window; Sanofi posted a master's-eligible Bayesian borrowing seat November 19 with a seven-day window) and often prefers or requires a PhD for biostatistics seats; read the qualification line before the title. Amgen runs a separate master's internship inside its statistics group (posted October 26), next to PhD-preferred wording. Moderna's biostatistics intern names master's students outright, while its epidemiology and biomarker statistics seats are PhD only. Mid-size biotechs split the same way: Genmab's Clinical & Statistical Programming intern asks for master's students, while Insmed's biostatistics intern asks for a PhD candidate. Regeneron posted its whole 2027 summer wave on October 28; its biostatistics and clinical science seats came down by November 12 with no close date ever shown. Gilead's October 16 batch listed PhD as *preferred* on most statistics reqs and still took master's students; its research AI seats (omics, chemistry, lab work) closed October 31. Contract research organizations hire master's statisticians at volume, but later and more rolling, and mostly in SAS: ICON's last US Biostatistics Intern posting (req JR101743) is gone from its board and no 2027 version is up yet. Device companies run their own calendars: Edwards' clinical track came down October 31 and its other tracks open January to April; Medtronic's master's window closed October 13. Health plans posted a wave at the end of September, mostly undergraduate, MBA or pharmacy seats; the graduate analytics seats came later, with Highmark's remote seats and CVS Health's Data Science seat posted in the second half of October. Some plans post far later: SCAN Health Plan in Long Beach posted last cycle's graduate Data Scientist Intern on May 16. [SCAN posting, last cycle](https://simplify.jobs/p/94e3dc1e-3287-40a5-8a13-a3fcb9452c79) Replies come late: Kite's Clinical Development Data Management seat closed October 16 and moved to interviews by November 20. No's tend to come sooner: Moderna's oncology biostatistics seat answered in eleven days. Posted close dates move, usually earlier: BMS re-posted its Patient Safety seat on November 3 with the close cut from November 26 to November 16, then took it down by November 12. BMS posted a remote Data Science intern for master's and PhD students on November 18 with a seven-day window (closes November 25). BMS posted its master's-eligible Data & Quantitative Sciences intern on November 11 with a November 27 close, took it down by November 17, then reposted it November 19 with a November 30 close. A seat that vanishes can come back, so a missing row is worth a second look a few days later. J&J's IDAR Analytics & Systems seat was posted November 9 with a November 16 close and came down November 10. J&J posts batches with short windows and sometimes moves them: its Oncology Epidemiology seat was re-posted October 16 with the close pushed a week to October 30. Merck's whole 2027 Future Talent wave (biostatistics, outcomes research, epidemiology) came down October 30 to 31, before its dates. Daiichi Sankyo posted its whole 2027 summer wave on its own careers site November 5 to 9, 43 seats in Basking Ridge: its R programming seats take master's students, while its Biostatistics and Data Management seat asks for a PhD student. Some big pharma statistics groups run a separate master's track with a winter deadline: Eli Lilly's MS Statistics intern sits next to its PhD seat and closes January 3, and Takeda's statistics internship takes PhD or master's candidates, due February 28. Of the 14 employers on the American Statistical Association's 2027 list, seven (Amgen, Astellas, Biogen, Daiichi Sankyo, Neurocrine, Novartis, Vertex) take PhD students only (both from the American Statistical Association's internship list, which it publishes each December). [ASA 2027 list](https://stattrak.amstat.org/2026/11/06/2027-internships/) Not every master's track waits for winter: Bayer's Statistician Intern (Pharmaceuticals Statistics US, Whippany or remote, open to master's students) was posted September 24 and was gone from Bayer's board by November 16. [Bayer posting](https://jobs.bayer.com/job/Residence-Based-Statistician-Intern-Resi/1431241433/) Research hospitals post on their own calendars and often pay less: Henry Ford's Division of Biostatistics takes graduate students at $18 an hour, applications through December 31, interviews in January. [Henry Ford form](https://redcap.hfhs.org/redcap/surveys/?s=AX83M7JKYHH7A8TJ) Research hospitals can also run a separate route: St. Jude matches graduate students to named faculty mentors, with rolling review through December. A few cancer centers run programs written for master's students: Memorial Sloan Kettering's GEMS takes only students in a master's program, though its work is genomic. [GEMS](https://www.mskcc.org/departments/epidemiology-biostatistics/educational-opportunities/gems)

items.title: Kaplan Life Care Planning: Statistics Intern
items.detail: New tonight, from the ASA list. A small private medico-legal firm wants one MS or PhD student to validate its web-based life expectancy calculator, with a possible paper and book. Apply by email to the physician named on the listing with your resume and a short note; no pay figure or dates given. Listed deadline December 31, 2026. [Apply](https://stattrak.amstat.org/2026/11/06/2027-internships/)

items.title: Amgen: Grad Intern, Product Quality Statistician
items.detail: New tonight. A remote statistics seat in Amgen Operations, May to August 2027, *Guided by experienced statisticians* on Quality, Regulatory and Process Development questions and on automated analyses. It is a master's internship (you need one year of the master's done by May, which you will); preferred: a concentration in applied or *Non-clinical Biostatistics*, Data Science, and R, SAS, JMP or Minitab. Manufacturing data, not patients, so it ranks below the trial seats. $35.34 to $41.20 an hour. Posted November 17, no close date shown, req R-261900. [Apply](https://amgen.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/Careers/job/United-States---Remote/Grad-Intern---Product-Quality---Global-Chemistry-Manufacturing---Controls-Statistician--Summer-2027-_R-261900)

items.title: Sanofi: 2027 Summer Internships, Swiftwater (pool)
items.detail: New tonight. One application for Sanofi's vaccine manufacturing site, up to 12 weeks from June 2027. Master's students in Data Science *or related field* are eligible. The closest disciplines to your training are *Pharmacovigilance* (monitoring medicine safety worldwide) and Manufacturing & Operations Digital & Data Science; the rest are engineering and supply chain, so it ranks below the Cambridge pool. Needs permanent US work authorization. $27 to $47 an hour. Posted November 18, closes December 11, req R2871183. [Apply](https://sanofi.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/SanofiCareers/job/Swiftwater-PA/XMLNAME-2027-Summer-Internship-Opportunities-Swiftwater-PA_R2871183)

items.title: Daiichi Sankyo: AI/ML Automation Pipelines Intern
items.detail: Build proof-of-concept Python and machine learning pipelines for clinical trial reporting: a code recommender for tables, listings and figures, metadata extraction from protocols and analysis plans, and a QC dashboard across studies. Fits your Python and scikit-learn work; it leans more on software than statistics. Open to master's or PhD students in biostatistics; R, R Shiny, Python and AI/ML listed as required. Summer 2027, about 37.5 hours a week, $17.23 to $58.15 an hour. Posted November 6, requisition 2502. [Apply](https://careers.daiichisankyo.com/job/Basking-Ridge-AIML-Automation-Pipelines-Intern-NJ-07920/61334244/)

items.title: Moderna: Intern, Biometrics
items.detail: Statistical Innovation & Data Analytics team. The preferred line is *Master, doctoral or advanced undergraduate Student in statistics, biostatistics, computational biology, health informatics*. Work covers clinical data (EDC, SDTM, ADaM), applied statistical modeling and AI-agent development; Python is required and R preferred, so it leans engineering more than the oncology seat. Full-time, June 7 to August 20, 2027. Posted September 29, req R19865. [Apply](https://modernatx.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/M_tx/job/Cambridge-Massachusetts/Intern--Biometrics_R19865)

items.title: Genmab: Clinical Development Data Science Intern
items.location: Princeton, New Jersey (hybrid, 3 days in office)
items.detail: Machine learning and language processing on trial protocols, safety data and regulatory documents, including survival analysis. It is written for a PhD student, then adds *Master's students with strong applied experience may also be considered*, and it asks for strong Python with PyTorch or TensorFlow. Your XGBoost project is the applied experience to lead with. Lower odds than the other two Genmab seats. Posted October 19, req R18165. [Apply](https://genmab.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/Genmab_Careers_Site/job/Princeton-NJ/Clinical-Development-Data-Science-Intern_R18165)

items.title: Amgen: Grad Intern, Knowledge Graph Applications
items.detail: You would build a knowledge graph of longitudinal patient journeys (treatments, clinical events, outcomes) and use graph methods on *epidemiology and real-world evidence questions*, working with data scientists and epidemiologists. Open to students in a *Master's or PhD program* in biostatistics, epidemiology or data science with *Python, R, or a comparable programming language*; claims or EHR data and graph tools (Neo4j, PyTorch Geometric) are preferred, so expect to be stretched on the graph side. $35.34 to $41.20 an hour. Posted November 13, req R-260625. [Apply](https://amgen.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/Careers/job/United-States---Remote/Grad-Intern---Knowledge-Graph-Applications--Summer-2027-_R-260625)

items.title: Northwestern Medicine: Information Services Intern
items.detail: Health system IT internship with five tracks; the *Analytics & Data* track uses SQL, Python, Power BI and Tableau. Open to associate's, bachelor's and master's students. Ranked low because it is IT data engineering more than statistics, and the posting says it is for *aspiring healthcare IT leaders*. 10 to 12 weeks, starts May 26 or June 9, 2027, $23 to $25 an hour. Application deadline December 31, 2026, req REF91169Z. [Apply](https://jobs.nm.org/job/chicago/information-services-intern-summer-2027/27763/99976192048)

items.title: Memorial Sloan Kettering: GEMS Master's Program
items.detail: Genomics Experience for Master's Students, in MSK's Department of Epidemiology & Biostatistics (private nonprofit cancer center). A 12-week paid summer program built for master's students: you must be *currently matriculated in a master level program (biostatistics, statistics or related field)*, so there is no PhD gate. Runs May 17 to August 6, 2027, with a stipend and a nominal housing payment. Listed last because the work is genomic team science. Needs a statement of interest (about 500 words), **three letters of recommendation** and a resume, all in one email to the address on the program page; due Monday, January 25, 2027. The page does not mention full-time conversion. [Apply](https://www.mskcc.org/departments/epidemiology-biostatistics/educational-opportunities/gems)

items.title: Amgen: Grad Intern, Target Safety Risk Weighting
items.detail: Safety-science tooling that combines *omics* data, clinical adverse-event data and real-world evidence into risk scores. Master's internships are open; preferred fields are *Toxicology, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Computer/Data Science*, with Python and R, and Shiny dashboards named as a plus. Listed last because the work leans genomic. Posted November 3, req R-259961. [Apply](https://amgen.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/Careers/job/United-States---Remote/Grad-Intern---Target-Safety-Risk-Weighting-and-Evaluation-Strategies--Summer-2027-_R-259961)

items.detail: Kite says US graduate and undergraduate intern positions are *typically posted from October through January*, with interviews and selections through early spring. items.title: Corcept: Biostatistics Intern, Redwood City
items.detail: Bay Area. Last cycle's posting took students *pursuing a master's degree or PhD in statistics, mathematics, data science or a related field*, with R, SAS or Python, at $26 to $32 an hour, on site, and came down January 6, 2026. Corcept's Greenhouse board listed 61 roles and no internship on November 8, so expect it before the new year. [Penumbra openings](https://jobs.lever.co/penumbrainc), [last cycle's posting](https://www.workingnomads.com/jobs/statistician-intern-summer-2026-penumbra)

Applications go through Takeda's careers site, where no 2027 statistics req shows yet; questions to biostatistics.intern@takeda.com. [ASA 2027 list](https://stattrak.amstat.org/2026/11/06/2027-internships/)

[Last cycle's posting](https://simplify.jobs/p/cfbe723e-9302-407c-8916-161866239f71)

Its Paycor board on November 8 still lists only two Spring 2027 co-ops (Analytical Development, Formulation Development) and no summer seat. [MannKind internships](https://mannkindcorp.com/internships/)

Other teams post into October; on November 8 its board still showed only those two intern seats. [Blue Shield program page](https://careers.blueshieldca.com/growth-development), [Actuarial posting](https://ecge.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_1003/job/20261874)

[Data Scientist Intern, last cycle](https://simplify.jobs/p/94e3dc1e-3287-40a5-8a13-a3fcb9452c79) [Data Analyst Intern, last cycle](https://simplify.jobs/p/60ba90ca-d4f3-4dc2-86d3-1e8f576504c2/Data-Analyst-Intern)

items.title: Ionis: summer intern program, Carlsbad
items.detail: The 2026 window was February 9 to April 30, open to undergraduate and graduate students. Expect similar for 2027. [Ionis intern program](https://ionis.com/careers/intern-program)

items.title: Acadia Pharmaceuticals: summer program, San Diego
items.detail: Its page still shows the 2026 program, mid June to late August, hybrid. It names no biostatistics seat. [Program page](https://acadia.com/en-us/careers/summer-internship-program)

items.detail: 34 roles on its board, no internship. It leans strategy, so it stays here until a real internship appears.

That is the group behind the Statistics & Decision Sciences seat you sent on October 14. Ask what the interview covered and what the team wants from a master's intern; the site has a contact page. [Personal site](https://mueller-mackk.github.io/)

[Career fairs page](https://sph.umich.edu/careers/employer-engagement/career-fairs.html)

items.detail: Named on MSK's GEMS page as the program director, in the Department of Epidemiology & Biostatistics. Questions go to the program email on that page. [GEMS page](https://www.mskcc.org/departments/epidemiology-biostatistics/educational-opportunities/gems)

Regeneron (Tarrytown, New York; Warren, New Jersey): its Biostatistics & Statistical Programming and Clinical Science interns came down by November 12. **Moderna** (Cambridge, Massachusetts): Oncology Biostatistics sent November 10, marked rejected November 21; Biometrics intern open; its epidemiology and biomarker seats are PhD only. **AstraZeneca** (Boston, Gaithersburg): Epidemiology sent November 10; **Statistics Summer Intern** (Gaithersburg, master's students, R required) open until January 14; Lung Cancer Evidence & Strategy closed November 16. **Bristol Myers Squibb** (Princeton, remote and six other sites): Statistical Programming and remote Data Science MS/PhD interns, both sent November 20; **Data & Quantitative Sciences** came down November 17 and was reposted November 19, closing November 30; Patient Safety came down before its date. **Sanofi** (Cambridge, Morristown): Biostatistics intern on an atopic dermatitis placebo Shiny app sent November 13; a second **Biostatistics** seat on the same placebo database (Bayesian borrowing) posted November 19, closing November 26; a Swiftwater manufacturing-site pool (Pharmacovigilance track) opened November 18; the Cambridge pool (Biostatistics, Medical Evidence Generation, Data Science; closes December 11) takes master's students; its EGDS, Clinical Statistical Modeling and Statistical Methodology interns are PhD only; a new Waltham data co-op runs six months. Alkermes (Waltham) lists no intern on November 17. **Daiichi Sankyo** (Basking Ridge, New Jersey): R Innovation Initiatives and AI/ML Automation Pipelines interns take master's students; its Biostatistics and Data Management intern is PhD only. **Gilead and Kite** (Foster City, El Segundo): the October batch closed (three sent; Kite Clinical Development Data Management moved to interview November 20); Kite's graduate seats post October to January. Merck (New Jersey) took its whole statistics wave down October 30 and 31. **Eli Lilly** (Indianapolis): MS Statistics Intern posted November 9, closes January 3. Novartis (East Hanover) lists no 2027 statistics intern on November 10. Novo Nordisk (Plainsboro) lists no US intern and Boehringer Ingelheim (Ridgefield) no statistics intern on November 11. Otsuka (Princeton), Astellas (Northbrook) and Eisai (Nutley) list no 2027 intern seat on November 12. Takeda (Cambridge): the ASA 2027 list confirms master's statistics interns, due February 28; the req is not up yet. Merck's remaining 2027 seats (Medical Affairs, Data, AI & Genome Sciences) are PhD only. Vertex and Ipsen list no summer statistics intern. Teva (Parsippany, New Jersey; Davie, Florida) lists 16 US summer 2027 interns on November 14, all commercial, manufacturing or undergraduate; none in statistics. Organon (Jersey City), Incyte (Wilmington, Delaware) and UCB (Smyrna, Georgia) list no US intern on November 15; Incyte's eleven intern seats are all in Europe. GSK and AbbVie: nothing that fits. Biogen (Cambridge, Massachusetts) lists only a January to June pharmacometrics co-op on November 16. **Genentech** also posted a master's-eligible Clinical Pharmacology intern on November 17 (obesity trial meta-analysis, R and Shiny, closes December 2) and a second on November 20 (oncology dose optimization, survival analysis, closes December 5). AbbVie, Takeda, Alnylam and GSK list no US statistics intern on November 18. Vertex (Boston) lists 2027 summer interns in lab, process and manufacturing data only on November 20. Jazz (Philadelphia, Palo Alto) lists no intern on November 21. Regeneron's two new 2027 summer seats on November 20 are business development strategy and workplace analytics. Exelixis (Alameda) and Lundbeck (Deerfield, Boston) list no US intern on November 22. Astellas (Northbrook), Biogen, Neurocrine (San Diego), Novartis and Vertex list 2027 statistics interns on the ASA list for PhD students only.

Ionis (Carlsbad, about February to April), MannKind (Westlake Village, Q4) and Acadia (San Diego) post later. Arrowhead (Pasadena), Revolution Medicines, Denali, Cytokinetics, Exelixis, BioMarin and Xencor: no intern posted. Insmed (New Jersey), Neurocrine and Vertex (Boston) ask for PhD students. [MannKind internships](https://mannkindcorp.com/internships/) **Amgen** added a remote master's Product Quality Statistician intern on November 17 (manufacturing statistics).
